managerUpdateRequestFailed: Unable to confirm the update request.
managerUpdateStartUnconfirmed: The operation has not yet been confirmed as started
managerUpdateProgressDescription: Steps and the journal refresh automatically. Closing this window does not stop the operation.
managerUpdateStageProgress: Progress shows stages, not an estimate of time remaining. The journal may catch up after services restart.
managerUpdateReconnecting: Connection temporarily unavailable. Reconnecting automatically; the Manager continues the operation and the journal will be retrieved.
managerUpdateRequestUncertain: Checking the current state automatically. Do not restart the operation without reviewing the journal.
managerInstallationAlreadyManaged: This installation is already managed by Mergeron Manager. No additional adoption is needed.
managerAutomaticDetection: Automatically checks for new images on the current channel (edge or latest) every five minutes. Updates are never installed without confirmation.
managerNewImageAvailable: A new Mergeron image is available.
managerImageChangesDescription: Changes between the installed and proposed images, from release notes or GitHub commits.
managerChangesUnavailable: A new image was detected, but its descriptions are unavailable. Review the comparison link before confirming.
managerChangesTruncated: The list is limited to 100 commits. Use the comparison link to view all changes.
managerUpdateSeparateFromSettings: This action checks prerequisites, then asks for confirmation before backing up, installing and restarting services. It is separate from saving settings.
managerUpdateSafetyDescription: The Manager saves the stopped application state, checks service health and restores the previous version if an update fails.
managerUpdateRollingBack: Restoring the previous version and saved data
managerUpdateRecoveryRequired: Recovery requires attention; new operations are blocked
managerUpdateBackupRetained: The backup is retained. Data written by the failed version is kept separately, not deleted.
managerUpdateBlocked: The plan is blocked by safety checks.
managerRollbackDataWarning: This stops the services and restores the previous version AND the saved application data. More recent data is kept separately. External /appdata files are never restored or deleted.
managerUpdateDowntimeWarning: The services will be unavailable while the backup and health checks run. The Manager stays available through its local socket. If checks fail, the saved version and application data will be restored. External /appdata files are outside the backup scope.
managerOperationInProgress: Another Manager operation is already in progress.
updateAdoptionDrift: The installation no longer matches its adopted state.
updateBlocked: The update is blocked by safety checks.
updateCandidateIdentityConflict: A replacement container changed unexpectedly. Recovery is paused to protect your data.
updateDockerOrFilesystemFailure: A Docker or storage operation failed. Check the Manager and Docker logs.
updateHealthCheckFailed: A service failed its health check.
updateHealthCheckTimeout: A service did not become healthy within the allowed time.
updateImageDigestUnavailable: An immutable published image digest is required.
updateImageNotAllowed: This image is not from an authorized repository.
updateInsufficientBackupSpace: There is not enough storage space for a safe backup.
updateJournalInvalid: The recovery journal does not match this stack.
updateOriginalIdentityConflict: An original container changed unexpectedly. Recovery is paused.
updatePlanChanged: The installation changed. Generate a new update plan.
updateRecoveryRequired: Complete recovery before starting another update.
updateRollbackUnavailable: Rollback is not available for this operation.
updateUnsupportedPersistentFile: The backup contains an unsupported special file. No update was applied.
